# Mott Group Property Services

> > Adelaide's leading provider of comprehensive building maintenance, repairs, and property services for residential and commercial clients.

Mott Group Property Services is an established Adelaide-based company with over 30 years of experience delivering integrated property maintenance and building services. They offer a full spectrum of trade services including plumbing, electrical, carpentry, painting, and specialized renovations for both residential and commercial properties.
